ratings_why.fun: The now-or-later choice every turn is a real puzzle and the late game snowballs nicely, but the first turns are shaky and most growth is 'when something arrives, buff'.
ratings_why.distinct: Buying a turn late at a discount, the Back Channel and the Hold as a hidden bench play unlike today's tribes, though Fly South returns look a bit alike on screen.

verdict_why: Officer Nyx doesn't say which Hold units join the fight, and that choice decides the hidden fleet build.

points.text: Officer Nyx doesn't say which 2 Hold units join the fight: oldest, biggest or your pick. Say the player marks them while recruiting, or name a rule like biggest first.

Turns 2 and 3 are thin: a Run made on turn 2 puts nothing on the board until turn 3, and only Mudslide Pup is a real early body. A second Tier 1 or 2 body that is good when Run would smooth the climb.
Creel Hauler is the cleanest Hold payoff; a Tier 5 or 6 card that does the same per Hold unit for the whole board would give the hidden fleet a capstone.
The tribe wins by size, not fight tricks. One more Start of Combat card that uses the Hold, like Nyx does, would give the fight a moment of its own.

standouts.why: Officer Nyx turns the Hold into a bench the opponent can't see, and fielded units come back to grow again.
Lantern Reach Lookout delivers the seed: a tier-above unit you can only smuggle in.
Nan Silverholt makes every arrival a copy, which speeds triples and feeds Pipe Stoker; a capstone you build towards.

weakest.why: Reedwhistle is a plain arrival buff that the other Ashore cards do better.
Kettle Sinker's +1 gold a turn is small, and its body won't win early fights.
Brandy Diver is a generic tribe-wide buff with an Ashore repeat; it doesn't shape the build.

flags.note: The Hold has no size limit, so a full hand plus many Runs and Seizes lets Creel Hauler grow without bound.
Pipe Stoker with Nan Silverholt and Pebble Jack sells two to three Created copies a turn, each buffing every Reed Runner.
Grisel Seizing the Back Channel gives a free Tier 6 unit plus +5/+5 to the Hold each quiet turn.
Lantern Skipper doubled by Pebble Jack gives about 70 stats a turn at Tier 5; hot but bounded by the hand.
Which Hold units Officer Nyx fields isn't stated.
